verdict.rationale: Kushki's own docs list a webhooks page, but only for card-present payments ('Webhooks para tarjeta presente'). Nothing in the pack shows how those deliveries work. missing for 10: webhook signature verification, automatic retry behavior, event delivery logs, replay/redelivery of events, webhook coverage for online payments, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on signed webhook deliveries with automatic retries, event logs, and replay to keep my system consistent with payment state
